config.label: Base URL of the fleet-memory backend (self-hosted)
config.description: Base URL of the fleet-memory backend (self-hosted). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:5100. The pre-rebrand name HINDSIGHT_URL is still read as a fallback.

config.label: Default memory bank ID for retain/recall
config.description: Default memory bank ID for retain/recall. The pre-rebrand variable MEMPALACE_BANK is still read as a fallback. Migrating from hindsight-mempalace-mcp? Set this to mempalace-main to keep reading your existing bank; see mcp-server/README.md.
